findings.current: Eleven days passed in the blink of an eye after we left the Sichuan Tang Clan.
findings.defect: Changes the elapsed time from seven days and nights to eleven days. The eleventh dawn occurs later in the chapter.
findings.rationale: 칠 주야 means seven days and nights; 열한 번째 서광 later identifies the eleventh dawn.
findings.replacement: Seven days and nights passed in the blink of an eye after we left the Sichuan Tang Clan.
findings.source: 사천당가를 떠난 직후, 칠 주야라는 시간이 눈 깜짝할 사이에 흘러갔다.

findings.current: “Yes. It’s taking longer than I expected.”
findings.defect: Makes the reply about elapsed travel time rather than how much faster they must go.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang has just asked whether they must increase their speed even beyond their current pace.
findings.replacement: “Yes. Faster than I thought we’d have to.”

findings.current: But even after a long time had passed and one of his descendants inherited the throne, nothing changed.
findings.defect: Changes a direct child of the founding ruler into an unspecified descendant.
findings.rationale: 그의 피를 이은 자식 중 하나 specifies one of his children, not merely a later descendant.
findings.replacement: But even after many years had passed and one of his own children inherited the throne, nothing changed.
findings.source: 그러나 그로부터 긴 세월이 흐르고, 그의 피를 이은 자식 중 하나가 황위를 이어받은 후에도 바뀌는 것은 아무것도 없었다.

summary: The draft changes the elapsed time and the founder’s family relationship, and misdirects one exchange about the pace they need to maintain.
